rationale: The target now states the literal no-prefactor bounded-variable Hoeffding conclusion requested by Exercise 2.6.4: one universal positive exponent constant is quantified before all data, the event is the one-sided centered upper tail, and the variance proxy is the sum of the individual squared interval widths. All 58 dependencies support those meanings, and all configured checks pass. Lean's total real division makes the zero-width displayed RHS equal to 1, whereas the source leaves division by zero unresolved; nevertheless the hypotheses force the degenerate tail probability to be zero, so each formulation implies the other at theorem level. The target is therefore faithful-equivalent and needs no adjudication.
